adjudication.rationale: In `embeddable-host.js.es6` `save()` always sets `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')` and then, on success, forces `host.category` to `Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId'))`. If no category is selected, `categoryId` can be `null`, while the server (`Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`) explicitly defaults blank `category_id` to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id`. The client then overwrites `host.category` with `findById(null)` (undefined), causing `{{category-badge host.category}}` to render blank and later `edit()` to do `this.get('host.category.id')` which can break when `host.category` is unset.
